name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.42.1: widen a canary to every machine without re-publishing. POST /api/v1/app-release/cohort (ag_admin) changes who gets the current release; the Fridge and Coil release cards gain a roll out to all machines button while the release is on a canary list. The forward-only publish guard rightly refuses the same versionCode twice, which left no way from canary to fleet short of a version bump that changed nothing. Cumulative over v6.42.0.
